acceptanceCriteria: The decision is recorded in the owning spec with a test pinning the chosen verdict.
body:
Source: w6 appmap-impact lane report (2026-10-11), branch claude/w6-appmap-impact 31fb799d8.

Observed: a hop that reaches only spec files gives `no-navigation-impact` while still listing those spec files.

Expected: a decision on whether that verdict is right, or whether the verdict or the listing should change.
title: Question: is no-navigation-impact right for a hop that reaches only spec files?
